title: Change your password and temporary passwords
summary: Change a password while signed in and choose your own password when an administrator requires it.
scenes: An administrator requires a new password

steps.say: If you know your password and want to change it, sign in normally and open Sign-in methods from the header.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Under Password, enter your current password, a new passphrase twice, and a current authenticator code. An email code cannot replace this authenticator check.
onScreen: Password · Last changed Nov 6, 2026 8:34 PM. Changing it signs out your other MERIT sessions. To make sure it's you, enter your current password and a code from your authenticator app. · Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · Current password * · New password * · At least 15 characters, up to 128. Long passphrases, spaces and international characters are supported. No special character

steps.say: Follow the minimum length shown. Passwords must match, must differ from your current one, and must pass the breached-password check.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
onScreen: Some fields need attention · Use at least 15 characters.

steps.say: Correct the form and choose Change password. Your other sessions are signed out; this browser continues in a new session.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: An administrator may give you a temporary password and require a change at your next sign-in. First complete your password and second-factor steps.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Choose your own new password before continuing. MERIT will keep returning to this page until the required change is complete.
onScreen: Choose a new password · Your MERIT administrator set a password for you. Choose your own before you continue, so only you know it. · Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · New password * · At least 15 characters, up to 128. Long passphrases, spaces and international characters are supported. No special characters are required. Common, compromised and account-based passwords are refused

steps.say: You already verified this sign-in, so this page asks only for your new password twice. Choose Save password and continue.
Use your chosen password for future sign-ins. Keep it private, and tell your administrator if you receive an unexpected password-change notice.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
